en: I keep the harbour tidy. Ropes coiled, nets dried, lost things kept safe until someone comes for them.
Lost things off the ferry? There's this duffel. It came off with the cargo, not the passengers, and nobody's claimed it.
A change of clothes inside, and a timetable with seat thirteen circled. So somebody rode over, ghost or no ghost.
Off with the cargo, not the passengers. Whoever owned that duffel didn't ride with the rest.
The duffel's owner came back for it at last. Rode over in a proper seat this time, they said.
